metrics: Complete normalized ROI RGBA bytes including alpha compared at1pixel/point. Record all4 channel absolute differences; additionally RGB difference only where both normalized alpha=255 to avoid assigning visible color meaning to transparent RGB. This alpha-semantic mask does not change the fixed spatial ROI. No pass threshold or PixelGate result.
native_geometry: Match frame.volume/frame.clip by existing scoped CLI labels, native role/action and shared content AXGroup; use report relative_to_main_outer_points and verify against screen minus canvas origin. Never treat inherited main_window.find identifier as target match. Compare stable/closed-end, retain within-report range checks.
outputs: Small text/target ICC only; no original or processed image copies.
raster_policy: If both embedded source profiles are valid supported RGB input profiles, transform each original fixed native ROI RGB8 through its own ICC to one fixed sRGB output profile via Pillow ImageCms/LittleCMS intent0(perceptual), flags0, no BPC. Preserve original alpha. If unsupported or conversion fails, stop processed raster stage and retain native/raw facts.
scale_policy: 13 only: fixed exact integer2x2 BOX downsample to709x616 at original window point phase(0,0), after sRGB conversion; Pillow RGBA resize uses premultiplied RGBa and unpremultiplies, on encoded8bit sRGB values, not linear light.14 stays1x. ROI is predeclared, not fitted.
